desc:
Blox League is a fast-paced car soccer game where every hit, boost, and goal matters. Pick your team, jump into the arena, and use speed, positioning, aerials, and teamwork to outplay the other side.


⚽ Score goals and keep the match going
🚗 Drive, jump, boost, and hit crazy shots
🔵 Battle for Blue Team or 🟠 Orange Team
🎮 Play on PC, mobile, and controller
🏆 Master your mechanics and dominate the field 
 
Can you become the best player in Blox League?

Like 👍 and Favorite ⭐ the game for updates!
